title: 第21章 王艳的离间计第22章 阴差阳错
content_zh:
叶开一愣，“干什么？”
“你身上没出汗吗？”
“出了啊。”
“你不想下来洗个澡吗？”
“想啊。”
叶开浑身粘糊糊的，早就想下河洗澡了，但是他有任务，要站岗放哨。
“那你就下来呗。”
“可是我要给你们站岗啊！”
“没事，不会有人来的，下来吧。”
“就算有人来，我们都在水里，安全着呢！”
叶开看了看河水，实在抵御不住那清凉的诱惑，就脱掉衬衫长裤，扑通一声，跳进水里。
王艳继续做陈曼的思想工作，“妹妹，你了解张怀涛吗？”
“当然了，我们是同事。”
“你知不知道他以前谈过十六次恋爱？”
王艳有意夸大了事实，张怀涛谈过十二次，当然十二次也不少了。
“啥？十六次！”陈曼瞪大了眼睛，
张怀涛今年二十六岁，就算是十八岁开始谈，八年谈了十六次！
一年要换两个女朋友！
“是啊，他们张家父子都很花心，见一个爱一个，看见女人就想上，我都后悔嫁到他们家。”
陈曼的心顿时凉了半截。

“昨晚，张怀涛还要非礼我妹妹，幸亏我发现的及时，要不然，我妹妹就被他糟蹋了！”王艳双手捂住眼睛，哭了起来。
“他竟然敢这么做？连自己的小姨都不放过？”
陈曼简直不相信自己的耳朵。
“他就是个畜生，不，连畜生都不如！呜呜呜……”
王艳光打雷不下雨，哭的很伤心，一点眼泪都没有。
陈曼安慰王艳：“姐，你就别伤心了，大不了你跟张有权离婚！”
“我遇人不淑，这一辈子都完了！”
“唉，我何尝不是遇人不淑啊，咱们姐妹真是同病相怜。”
“妹妹，你比比我强，趁着还没嫁给张怀涛，赶紧回头！”
“嗯嗯。”
“我看叶开很适合你，他是大学生，他以后不会总窝在农村的。”
“姐姐，我不着急找对象，我想先把张怀涛的事情解决了再说。”
“也行，妹妹，你的身材真好。”王艳在陈曼身上捏了几把。
content_en:
Ye Kai was stunned, "What are you doing?"
"Aren't you sweating?"
"It's out."
"Don't you want to come down and take a shower?"
"Think so."
Ye Kai was all sticky and wanted to take a bath in the river for a long time, but he had a mission and had to stand guard.
"Then you come down."
"But I have to stand guard for you!"
"It's okay, no one will come, come down."
"Even if someone comes, we are all in the water and safe!"
Ye Kai looked at the river water and couldn't resist the cool temptation, so he took off his shirt and trousers, jumped into the water with a plop.
Wang Yan continued to do Chen Man's ideological work, "Sister, do you know Zhang Huaitao?"
"Of course, we are colleagues."
"Did you know that he had been in love sixteen times before?"
Wang Yan deliberately exaggerated the facts. Zhang Huaitao talked about it twelve times, of course twelve times was quite a few.
"What? Sixteen times!" Chen Man's eyes widened.
Zhang Huaitao is twenty-six years old this year. Even if he started dating when he was eighteen, they have talked about it sixteen times in eight years!
Two girlfriends a year!
"Yes, the Zhang family and his son are very carefree. They fall in love with each other and want to have sex with women when they see them. I regret marrying into their family."
Chen Man's heart suddenly went cold.
"Last night, Zhang Huaitao also molested my sister. Fortunately, I found out in time, otherwise, my sister would have been raped by him!" Wang Yan covered her eyes with her hands and started crying.
"How dare he do this? Not even sparing his own aunt?"
Chen Man simply couldn't believe his ears.
"He is just a beast, no, even worse than a beast! Wuwuwu..."
Wang Yanguang cried very sadly without any tears at all.
Chen Man comforted Wang Yan: "Sister, don't be sad. In the worst case, you and Zhang have the right to divorce!"
"If I meet someone unkind, my whole life will be over!"
"Oh, I am not a kind person to others. We sisters really have the same problem."
"Sister, you are better than me. Before you marry Zhang Huaitao, hurry up and turn around!"
"Yeah."
"I think Ye Kai is very suitable for you. He is a college student. He will not always stay in the countryside in the future."
"Sister, I'm not in a hurry to find a partner. I want to resolve Zhang Huaitao's matter first."
"That's okay, sister, you have such a good figure." Wang Yan pinched Chen Man a few times.
